veranderings.na: bring baie van die rots na bo
veranderings.rede: 'daarvan' can be read as the air named in the first clause; naming the rock makes clear what mining brings up.

veranderings.voor: Water by 'n myn wat suur word
veranderings.na: Water wat by 'n myn suur word
veranderings.rede: As written the relative clause attaches to 'myn' (a mine that turns acid); moving 'wat' next to 'Water' ties it to the water.
